import {
  SelectRoot,
  SelectLabel,
  SelectControl,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValueText,
  SelectClear,
  SelectPositioner,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectItemText,
  SelectItemIndicator,
  SelectGroup,
  SelectGroupLabel,
  SelectHiddenInput,
} from '@uifn/components-react/select'
import '@uifn/components/styles.css'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <SelectRoot items={[{"id":"item-1","value":"item-1","label":"Member","textValue":"Member"},{"id":"item-2","value":"item-2","label":"Administrator","textValue":"Administrator"},{"id":"item-3","value":"item-3","label":"Viewer","textValue":"Viewer","disabled":true}]} defaultValue="item-1" name="select">
      <SelectLabel>Workspace role</SelectLabel>
      <SelectControl>
        <SelectTrigger type="button">
          <SelectValueText />
        </SelectTrigger>
        <SelectClear type="button">×</SelectClear>
      </SelectControl>
      <SelectPositioner>
        <SelectContent>
          <SelectItem value="item-1">
            <SelectItemText value="item-1">Member</SelectItemText>
            <SelectItemIndicator value="item-1">✓</SelectItemIndicator>
          </SelectItem>
          <SelectItem value="item-2">
            <SelectItemText value="item-2">Administrator</SelectItemText>
            <SelectItemIndicator value="item-2">✓</SelectItemIndicator>
          </SelectItem>
          <SelectItem value="item-3">
            <SelectItemText value="item-3">Viewer</SelectItemText>
            <SelectItemIndicator value="item-3">✓</SelectItemIndicator>
          </SelectItem>
          <SelectGroup value="item-1">
            <SelectGroupLabel value="item-1">Available roles</SelectGroupLabel>
          </SelectGroup>

import { FieldRoot, FieldLabel, FieldControl, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldRequiredIndicator } from '@uifn/components-react/field'
import '@uifn/components/styles.css'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <FieldRoot required>
      <FieldLabel htmlFor="work-email">
        Work email <FieldRequiredIndicator>*</FieldRequiredIndicator>
      </FieldLabel>
      <FieldControl>
        <input
          id="work-email"
          name="email"
          type="email"
          placeholder="you@company.com"
          autoComplete="email"
          required
        />
      </FieldControl>
      <FieldDescription>We will only use this for account notifications.</FieldDescription>
      <FieldError />
    </FieldRoot>
  )
}
